description: In front of you on the bed are a yellow cup filled with small clear ice cubes, a gray plastic tray, and a purple scoop resting to the right. The left hand reaches in to grasp the yellow cup, lifts it over the gray tray, tilts and rotates it downward to dump the ice cubes into the tray, then turns the cup upright and sets it back down, while the right hand stays near the purple scoop without picking it up.
